name: mictape
title: MicTape
description: Record your microphone to .m4a files in folders you choose, with a menu bar timer
author: t4kamuna

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.subtitle: MicTape
commands.description: Pick a destination and start recording in the background

commands.name: stop-recording
commands.title: Stop Recording
commands.subtitle: MicTape
commands.description: Stop the current recording and save it

commands.name: recording-status
commands.title: Recording Status
commands.subtitle: MicTape
commands.description: Show the elapsed time of the current recording in the menu bar

preferences.name: hideWhenIdle
preferences.title: When Not Recording
preferences.label: Hide the menu bar item
preferences.description: Hide the menu bar item while nothing is being recorded

commands.name: test-microphone
commands.title: Test Microphone
commands.subtitle: MicTape
commands.description: Record five seconds and check the input level

commands.name: configure
commands.title: Recording Settings
commands.subtitle: MicTape
commands.description: Choose where recordings are saved and how files are named

preferences.name: mictapePath
preferences.title: MicTape CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the mictape command. Leave empty to look in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, and /usr/local/bin.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
